candidates.statement: • DMEPA and DMPP staff should discuss and seek to reach scientific agreement in a timely manner. 9
candidates.context: 2. If the DMEPA SE has any questions concerning the completed DMPP patient- oriented labeling review, they will contact the DMPP reviewer to discuss and reach alignment. 3. DMEPA will reference the DMPP consult review in DMEPA’s HF validation study protocol review.
